newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: IMF mission to visit Kazakhstan in February.
newsitem.headline: IMF mission to visit Kazakhstan in February.

text.p: The International Monetary Fund will send a mission to oil-rich Kazakhstan next month, an IMF official said on Monday.
"There's likely to be a visit sometime in February but the date has not been fixed yet," David Hoelscher, the IMF's resident representative in Kazakhstan, told Reuters.

He said the visit would follow the IMF's first review of Kazakhstan's three-year $446 million loan -- an extended fund facility agreed last July -- at an IMF board meeting in Washington on January 17.
Kazakh President Nursultan Nazarbayev's government is aiming at economic growth of around two percent this year, up from around 0.5 percent in 1996.
The government also aims to cut annual inflation to 19 percent in the former Soviet republic this year from around 30 percent in 1996.
